narrative.headline: Brentford's attacking mid and striker positions are clear weaknesses that are costing us the title challenge.
narrative.summary: Brentford sit third in the Premier League estimated standings with a squad valued at EUR 584.8M, below the league average of EUR 658.6M. We outscore the league average on goals (2.0 vs 1.35 per game) and lead the entire league on aerial duels won (21.8 per game), but our pass accuracy (76.42%) and shots on target (4.6 per game) trail the top three sides by 10.5% and 14.2% respectively. The biggest opportunity is upgrading the attacking midfielder and striker roles, where our current output is well below both the league average and the contenders.
title_plan: Pass accuracy is our biggest technical gap: at 76.42% we are 10.5% behind the top sides' 85.39%, ranking 18th in the league. Better technical players in central and attacking midfield would close this immediately.

Shots on target (4.6 per game, ranked 10th) lag the top sides by 14.2%. Our attacking mid scores 0 goals/90 and 0 assists/90, both bottom 18% and bottom 29% respectively among Premier League attacking midfielders.

Our striker generates only 0.2 goals/90 (bottom 34% among Premier League strikers) versus contenders averaging 0.65. Fixing the striker role is the single fastest route to matching the top sides' goal output of 2.35 per game.
money_plan: EUR 30.3M in market value is at risk from five expiring contracts in 8 months. The 30-year-old central midfielder (market value EUR 10M, 15% of minutes) is the priority to resolve; the others are playing little or no football and can be allowed to leave.

A 21-year-old wide forward (market value EUR 28M) is taking only 9% of the minutes of our most-used player. A loan move now would build his value and free up squad space, with a sale later representing a significant capital gain.

Our realistic budget is EUR 45M per signing. A 22-year-old Eredivisie striker at a market value of just EUR 800K represents exceptional value; a 22-year-old Eredivisie attacking midfielder at EUR 13M is also well within budget and saves an estimated EUR 63.7M versus buying from a top-side equivalent.
success_plan: Immediate priority: sign an attacking midfielder this window. The 22-year-old from the Eredivisie (market value EUR 13M, top 12% in his league) offers 0.8 assists/90 and 2.2 shots on target/90, directly addressing our worst-rated position at a fraction of top-side cost.

Alongside the attacking mid, bring in a striker. The 22-year-old from the Eredivisie (market value EUR 800K) is the standout value option: top 3% for key passes/90 (2.67) and top 8% for aerials won/90 (6.91) in his league, with 0.89 goals/90 versus our current 0.2.

Over the next 12 months, resolve the five expiring contracts before they expire for free, loan out the 21-year-old wide forward (EUR 28M market value) to protect and grow his value, and begin addressing fullback tackling (bottom 19% in the Premier League) in the summer window.
